_comment: Two interpolation surfaces live in this file. (1) Generator-time: tokens like Audio Tools are uppercase-snake-case placeholders replaced by `vrooli scenario generate` before the scenario is built — they appear as literal display values at runtime. (2) Runtime: tokens like {{count}} are i18next interpolation, replaced by `t(key, { count })` at render time. Keys that start with an underscore (like this one) are sentinels — skipped by the codegen, parity test, and unused-key audit.

app.title: Audio Tools
app.description: Shared audio capabilities — speech-to-text, text-to-speech, summarization, transcoding — with BYOK / Vrooli / Local provider routing.

config.description: Provider routing, BYOK credentials, and effective environment overrides.
config.providerRoutingDescription: Per-capability tier enablement. Precedence is BYOK → Vrooli → Local. ErrInsufficientCredits short-circuits.

voices.localHealthDescription: Locally-run providers feeding the Local tier.
voices.localHealthFollowUp: Live probes land once SettingsService.ListLocalResourceHealth ships.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Send a manual call and observe the provider trace. Verifies BYOK → Vrooli → Local routing end-to-end.
diagnostics.transcribeDescription: Upload an audio file (mp3/wav/flac/aac/ogg). Routed via the STT provider chain.
diagnostics.summarizeDescription: Send free-form text through the summarization chain.
diagnostics.synthesizeDescription: Render text through the TTS provider chain and return audio bytes.
diagnostics.synthesizeFollowUp: Synthesize UI lands once the REST multipart streaming response is wired to the player primitive. Track audio-tools-synthesize-player in the swarm-manager backlog.
diagnostics.transcodeDescription: Convert between audio formats via the local audio service.
diagnostics.transcodeFollowUp: Transcode UI lands once the binary download/save round-trip is exposed through the same multipart seam as transcribe.
diagnostics.traceDescription: Most-recent calls and which tier handled them.
diagnostics.traceEmpty: Run a diagnostic to populate the trace. The tier, provider, model, and latency appear here per call.
